login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to your Zoodomo member area.
login.heroTitle: Your online showcase to present your animals, without writing a line of code.
login.heroSubtitle: Zoodomo is built for shelters and professional sellers: showcase your animals for adoption or sale on a page in your own colors, linked from your website or shared directly if you don't have one yet.
login.legalPrefix: By signing in, you agree to Zoodomo's
login.featurePersonalize: No technical skills needed: fill in your animal profiles, the result is always clean and responsive.
login.featureLanguages: Keep your identity: your colors, your logo, a page to share anywhere, with or without a website.
login.featureShare: Multilingual: your content and your visitors in French, Dutch and English.
login.featureReminders: Your animal profiles always up to date, with an automatic reminder if a profile hasn't been edited in a while.

signup.title: Create your Zoodomo account
signup.subtitle: A few details to get started.
signup.name: Business name
signup.error: An account already exists with this email.

legalPage.placeholder: This page will be completed before Zoodomo's public launch.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.greeting: Hello {name}, here is an overview of your animals.
dashboard.addressMissingNotice: Add your address in Account to show it on your public page and printed listings.

fiches.title: My animals
fiches.markAdoptedAria: Mark {name} as adopted and remove from public pages
fiches.markAdoptedConfirm: Mark {name} as adopted? The listing will stay visible on the public pages for 7 days, then disappear automatically.
fiches.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? This action cannot be undone.

form.requiredHint: Fields marked with * are required, the others are not.
form.name: Name
form.subspeciesPlaceholder: e.g. Labrador, Mixed breed, German Shepherd...
form.birthDatePreciseHint: If known (day + month), shown instead of the year of birth on the public listing.
form.statusHint: The listing is visible as soon as it's created. "Reserved" and "Adopted" show a banner on the photo; "Adopted" stays visible for 7 days, then disappears from the public pages automatically.
form.contentHint: To fill in for each language activated for the account (Account tab).
form.badgesHint: One badge per listing, shown as a small card in the corner of the photo.
form.badgePreviewCaption: Example: this is how the badge appears in the top corner of the photo.
form.badgeLabelPlaceholder: e.g. Senior, SOS, Waiting for a home since 2023...
form.photosHint: Up to 5 photos, compressed automatically (real upload to Supabase Storage planned later).
form.photosDropLabel: Click or drag your photos here
form.contactHint: If left empty, the account's general contact is shown on the animal page.

compte.title: Account
compte.contactRequiredHint: At least one of the two (email or phone) is required: it's the only way a visitor can contact you from your animal listings.
compte.contactRequiredError: Provide at least a public contact email or phone number.
compte.addressVisibleLabel: Share my address (public page and printed listings)
compte.companyNumberVisibleLabel: Share my company number (public page and printed listings)
compte.aboutHint: Text and photos shown in the "Discover us" section of your public page.
compte.websiteUrlHint: Used for the "Back to our website" link shown on your public pages.
compte.loginEmailHint: Only the login email cannot be changed here.
compte.languesHint: Choose which languages you write your animal profiles in (description, ideal home). If you check several, you will need to fill in the content in each. Your visitors will be able to switch between these languages on your public pages.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.filterHint: A proposed year may match when a listing was created rather than actual views: a year with no recorded view shows 0.

messages.title: Messages
messages.welcomeBody: Glad to have you on board. To get started: fill in your information and contact details under the Account tab, add your first animal listing from My animals, then customize the look of your public pages under the Customization tab. You can then share the link to your pages wherever you like.
messages.staleBody: {name}'s listing hasn't been updated in over {days} days. Check that it's still up to date (availability, information) from My animals.
messages.contactSentConfirmation: Message sent, the Zoodomo team will reply by email.
messages.contactRequiredError: Please describe your request before sending.

personnalisation.title: Customization
personnalisation.intro: These settings apply to all your public pages: home, categories and animal listings.
personnalisation.policeHint: Choose the writing style for your public pages.
personnalisation.colorsHint: Applied to buttons, titles and backgrounds on your public pages.
personnalisation.colorPrimaryHint: Used for buttons, icons, links and badges on your public pages (not your organization's name, which always stays black).
personnalisation.colorSecondaryHint: Used for the header, footer, contact block and soft backgrounds (icons, cards) on your public pages.
personnalisation.logoHint: Shown at the top of every public page, so your visitors clearly recognize your organization.
personnalisation.logoDropLabel: Click or drag your logo here
personnalisation.logoMaxReached: Only one logo at a time: remove the current one to add another.
personnalisation.especesHint: How species (Dog, Cat, ...) are displayed on your account's home page.

liste.label: List
liste.hint: One species per row, full width.

vitrine.label: Showcase
vitrine.hint: Large colored cards with an icon, no photo.

personnalisation.presentationHint: How your presentation text and account photos are displayed on the home page.

texte_photos.label: Text then photos
texte_photos.hint: Centered text, your photos aligned below.

photo_texte.label: Photo and text
photo_texte.hint: Your photos (smaller) on the left, the text framed on the right.

texte_photo.label: Text and photo
texte_photo.hint: The text framed on the left, your photos (smaller) on the right.

personnalisation.dispositionHint: Applies to the animal list per category; the individual animal listing always keeps a fixed layout.

empilee.label: Stacked
empilee.hint: One listing per row, photo and info side by side.

alternee.label: Alternating
alternee.hint: Listings alternate photo left then right.
